title: Attribute unlanded work to a live claim, not only to prose
goal: With five workers running, the readiness board reports two false alarms at every sync: a roster tree mid-task is flagged as dirty (expected while working) and a tree holding unlanded work is flagged as untracked even though its token holds a live claim on a task (Claude's load-worktree case). The check reads a tree's unlanded work against open task text only, so it cannot see that a claim is already the tracking. Attribute a worktree that holds a live, unexpired claim in its own local claim refs as in-progress, and keep failing genuinely unattributed work, which is the hazard the check exists for.
